1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device __compares a sequence or temporal ordering of the document actions with a sequence or temporal ordering of the demonstrated user actions__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __and determines whether the demonstrated user actions match the current step within a defined tolerance threshold__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification __with visual feedback indicating alignment confidence__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by predicting the next step from the sequence of demonstrated user actions__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __in anticipation of the user's next action__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification __with predictive highlighting__.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on __a combination of common strings and action sequence patterns__ in the user interface and the documented procedure.

10. (Original)

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on __a learned model derived from__ previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps __and organizing them into a hierarchical structure__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that includes temporal sequence analysis__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, __wherein the alignment device continuously monitors the demonstrated user actions and dynamically updates the alignment in real-time__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on __a learned model derived from__ previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that compares sequences and temporal orderings of the actions__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __and determining whether the demonstrated user actions match the current step within a defined tolerance threshold__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by predicting the next step from the sequence of demonstrated user actions__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __in anticipation of the user's next action__.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on __a combination of common strings and action sequence patterns__ in the user interface and the documented procedure.

24. (Original)

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on __a learned model derived from__ previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure __and organizing them into a hierarchical structure__.

28.
